name: Platformer Double Jump
description: I Wanna Be The Guy style double jump for platformer mode. Just tap the screen in the air.

enabled.name: Double Jump
enabled.description: Turn the mod on or off.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description:
<cg>Tap</c>: one tap = one air jump.
<cy>Hold</c>: tap in the air, then keep holding to keep flying up for a moment (like the robot).

air-jumps.name: Air Jumps
air-jumps.description: How many extra jumps you get in the air. 1 = double jump, 2 = triple jump...

jump-power.name: Jump Power
jump-power.description: Strength of the air jump. 1.0 = same as a normal jump.

hold-time.name: Hold Time (sec)
hold-time.description: Hold mode: how long you can keep flying while holding.

hold-power.name: Hold Power
hold-power.description: Hold mode: climb speed while holding (fraction of a normal jump).
